en: A black and white photograph of a quiet, gently sloping street lined with early 20th-century European buildings on both sides. There are fences, a couple of telegraph poles, and a horse-drawn carriage visible in the middle distance. In the far background, an industrial smokestack is visible. A sign on a building to the right side of the street reads 'Papierhandlung Albert Gä.', suggesting a paper or stationery shop.
